Hawkeye saves the life of a colonel who wants him reprimanded for disrespect. BJ tries to save the marriage of a friend who found out his wife is cheating on him.
A fever of unknown origin is sending men into the hospital at an alarming rate. Frank contracts the fever just as he's about to choose the 'soldier of the month'.
The vintage revolver of a wounded officer is stolen from the camp's gun locker and Radar is accused as the thief. Hawkeye figures out who the real culprit is.

Elmo's wine bar opens to mixed reactions, while Jacko and Eric make an Italian connection.
Heartwarming good news stories from the UK and beyond.
Babs' old friend, Julian Chichester, comes to stay at Shreelane. He begins to scorn the Major's household, including a beloved dog.

Young restaurateur Archie McDonald is tricked into returning to Glenbogle by his eccentric parents, Hector and Molly, and finds the estate is on the verge of bankruptcy.
A ruthless banker informs the family that if they can't pay the outstanding debt, the bank will close Glenbogle. Desperate to save his home, Archie pulls out all the stops.
Archie's girlfriend and business partner, Justine, has arrived from London to find out what he is up to while Killwillie asks the family to host the Glenbogle ball in his place.
A genealogist comes to Glenbogle looking for the rightful heir to the Ballantine clan. Meanwhile, he reveals a secret tie between the MacDonald family and Katrina.
Archie's sister Lizzie turns up with her boyfriend and a group of massage therapists intent on turning Glenbogle into a healing centre, meanwhile Golly goes missing.
Caroline travels to an influenza-ridden mining camp with Dr Baker after she receives a plea for help from an old friend who is pregnant and desperately ill.
Part 1: During a trip to Sleepy Eye, James and Albert walk into a bank robbery. James is critically wounded, and the doctor tells James is expected to die. Part 1 of 2.
Part 2: Charles, unable to deal with the mounting pressure concerning his son's critical condition, becomes verbally abusive to his family and friends. Part 2 of 2.
Part 1: Having suffered hard times and wanting to find a better life, the Ingalls family move to the city, selling their land to the Carter family. Part 1 of 2.
Part 2: Almanzo's brother Royal reveals he has a serious heart condition and sadly passes away. Jenny blames Laura for his death and feels she can't go on. Part 2 of 2.
Mrs Oleson finds some old Walnut Grove bonds and promises not to cash them in if the town elects her as mayor! The townsfolk fight back with their own candidate.
Mr Stark is denied a bank loan; this sends him over the edge, and he shoots his wife and daughter. He hides in Laura's house, convinced that she and Jenny are his wife and daughter.
Hawkeye, Margaret and Klinger are sent to a frontline aid station under heavy fire to fill in for a dead surgeon.
Frank blames a young Korean assistant, Mr Kwan, for his mistakes in the OR. Hawkeye and Trapper befriend Kwan and try to reunite him with his pregnant wife.
The camp prepares for a visit from General Douglas MacArthur, but not all personnel are excited; Klinger, in his drag, is told to keep out of sight.
Hawkeye has been given the job of acting paymaster. When the job is done, Hawkeye slips Radar a left over 10 dollars which prompts the wrath of a zealous payroll clerk.
When Whicher offers to help a country lady find her niece, he's drawn into a disturbing murder case that pits him against wealthy, powerful figures and his former police colleagues.

Giant sturgeons are farmed for the delicacy of Russian caviar. Workers create soccer cleats worn by the sport's greatest players.
Danish bomb squads find and dispose of thousands of World War II landmines. Weed eaters chop down growth with just a sliver of nylon.
Hunting for rare treasures, the team visit a colourful collection of Americana, a historic shipping warehouse, and a huge indoor flea market in Wales.
Modern-day treasure hunter Drew Pritchard is in Staffordshire to get access to a private collection of a pub owner, who has been hoarding antiques for over half a century.
With Drew busy hunting for antiques, Paul heads to a classic car auction near the Malvern Hills. Paul sees big potential in a MGA 1600, even though it doesn't start up.
More everyday items are put under the microscope as we discover how they are made, including stainless steel, football helmets, resin figurines and laboratory glassware.
More everyday items are put under the microscope as we discover how they are made, including fire extinguishers, doughnuts, shock absorbers and banjos.
Teleshopping.
Teleshopping.
Around the world, there are extraordinary building mistakes. Design teams and experts analyse what went wrong and how engineers are fixing them.
A customer realises his Top Gun bike dream and the Cog put on an ambitious event. Roy gives Richard a hard time over the slow progress on his Morgan.
The 24-Hour Test. Sam joins an all-female team for a 24-hour 2CV race. Can they beat mechanical trouble, reach the finish and get one over on the men.
The boys mark the MGB's 60th anniversary in style by buying and fixing up one of these classic motors. But the upgrades come with hefty costs.
This BMW was more driver-focused and handled better than its contemporaries. Will Edd be able to resurrect a 1970s relic not started for two decades.
Mike is in the Pacific Northwest, where he has tracked down a true 'barn find': A Volvo Amazon 122 with a rally heritage. Ant is tasked with making it roadworthy.
Mike heads out to Poland to bag a Lamborghini Uracco. However, the price of this classic is rising due to Lamborghini's 50th anniversary, can Mike bag a bargain.
Saab 9-3. Mike wants a high performance car with an historic badge, but it's hard to find a Saab 9-3 Turbo at a good price. With tight margins will Edd have any room for manoeuvre.
Car dealing legends Mike and Ant are in their west coast workshop in the US, searching, buying, restoring, testing and selling more great motors in the American market.
MotoGP: Portugal Sprint Race. History will be made if Marc Marquez wins in Portugal and secures his 10th World Championship at one of the world's most spectacular circuits.
Peter And Cat / RAF Truck. Henry and Fuzz view an exquisite collection of military and civilian vehicles in Guildford. What will they sell to the drummer from a British rock band.
Henry and Fuzz sail over to the Isle of Wight. They meet Vince, a fanatical collector whose sheds are bursting with British and Japanese bikes.
Henry and Fuzz are overwhelmed by Nick from Brackley's military collection. They leave with a vintage rarity, but will they find a buyer for something so unique.
Henry and Fuzz rummage through David's hoard of Italian bikes in Norfolk. They're smitten by his Ducatis and his rare Mot Guzzis, but just what will he sell.
Henry and Fuzz head to Lincolnshire to see Kevin's collection of vintage lorries and trucks. They find a Cornish fire engine, but is it too hot to handle.
Henry and Fuzz are staying local, visiting Francis' farm in Oxfordshire. There's tractors, bikes and trinkets, but what will they come away with.
A customer realises his Top Gun bike dream and the Cog put on an ambitious event. Roy gives Richard a hard time over the slow progress on his Morgan.
The 24-Hour Test. Sam joins an all-female team for a 24-hour 2CV race. Can they beat mechanical trouble, reach the finish and get one over on the men.
A pair of sisters bring in a family bike that travelled around the world with them. Plus, a woman brings in a leather case that belonged to her great aunt for restoration.
Alex visits two Italian brothers who, despite having 20 years in the business, own a failing hotel. Can Alex help them rediscover their love for hospitality.
Opalton Boulder Crew are going to the Winton Opal Festival, Slim Pickings are finally at White Peg, and the Mooka Boys have driven to Coober Pedy.
Charlene Wold has a seemingly perfect family life. But her son, Logan, develops addiction problems that eventually spiral into a horrific crime.
When teenager LaTonya Taylor gets pregnant, her mum vows to support her no matter what. But someone's hiding resentment that will destroy the whole family.
When teens Zainab and Ammar fall in love, their relationship is forbidden by her father - who will stop at nothing to ensure that his rules of honour are obeyed.
When lonely teen Meagan Grunwald meets handsome felon Angel Garcia, it's love at first sight. But their whirlwind romance leaves a trail of death and devastation.
A lively slumber party in the town of McMinnville turns into a nightmare when a loving mother, her young daughter, and her daughter's friend, are murdered.
In Dunlap, Tennessee, a body is found on the banks of the river. Detectives piece together the unknown man's final moments to find the culprit.

When Colleen Orsborn disappears after skipping school to go to the beach, sightings of a serial killer lead the investigation down a sinister path.
Mike Williams goes duck hunting on a lake and disappears. Some say alligators ate him but when police investigate, they uncover evidence of foul play.
A feisty trucking company manager vanishes from her home without a trace. The case takes a terrifying turn when her purse is found near the lair of a serial killer.

It's the day of the London Marathon! Peppa and family come to cheer Daddy on. Peppa and George see many runners dressed in funny costumes - and then they spot Daddy.
Grandpa is building something in his shed. It is his latest pet project. It's a robot called Frank.
Peppa and her friends are at playgroup. Madame Gazelle is teaching the children fun games to play with paper.
Mummy, Daddy, Peppa and George are going to the seaside. Mummy and Daddy explain clouds to Peppa and George who have a little sing and dance about clouds.
Ben and Holly are excited when they learn that Nanny Plum is a Tooth Fairy at night, and go along with her to pick up a little girl's tooth. But the little girl is not so little.
When Captain Squid leaves his treasure map in the Little Kingdom, Redbeard the Elf Pirate leads Ben, Holly and Nanny Plum on a treasure hunt.
On their second day in Australia the Kangaroo family take the Pig family to the beach where they try out surfing. George shows off his skills when he's out paddling with Daddy Pig.
Today the family go to work with Mrs Kangaroo on the Great Barrier Reef. While taking in the beautiful views in Mrs Kangaroo's submarine, they find some special treasure.
The holiday is coming to an end but there's still time to play with a Boomerang and make friends with Mr Wallaby. They all have trouble keeping the boomerang under control, though.
Madame Gazelle and the playgroup are sharing their best nursery rhymes with each other.
Peppa and her family are visiting Cousin Chloe's House to play with Baby Alexander. Peppa learns babies are not like dolls at all, and do lots of things every day.
Peppa hands Penny and Pedro the wrong glasses by mistake and they can't see very well. Madame Gazelle then tells them the importance of lenses and how they're in all sorts of things.
It's a snowy day and Peppa's family build an igloo for their snowman. They then hide away in it during the snowstorm, but Penny Polar Bear and her parents love snowstorms and Peppa's igloo too.
Peppa receives an invite to Candy Cat's birthday party - on a double decker bus.
Peppa and friends are at Penny Polar Bear's house for a movie night. But before they can watch it, the children need to decide where to sit, and which popcorn to eat.
Granny Sheep and Suzy take Granny Pig and Peppa around Art House Day. After a day full of screen printing and silhouette miniatures, Granny Pig finds the perfect artwork.
The Slowest Race in the World: When Thomas, Kana, and Diesel 'race' to see who can go the slowest, their lack of speed provides challenges - and lets Thomas see what he might have missed.
An injured bat can't remember who she is in 'The Bat Who Couldn't Remember', and then in 'The Hidden Hitchhiker', Sam and Kit get stuck together.
Mr Curry is sure there's a monster in the park lake in 'Paddington and the Lake Monster', and in 'Paddington's Space Radio', Toq wants to let her dad know she's thinking of him up in space.
Paddington helps Mateo dress up in 'Paddington and the Three Musketeers', then in 'Paddington and the Dinosaur Hunt', Paddington, Simi and Jonathan are on a dinosaur hunt in the park.
Things go missing in Windsor Gardens in 'Paddington's Journey into a Black Hole', then in 'Paddington's Rainbow Race!', Simi and Paddington try to find the gold at the end of rainbow.
With a new baby on the way, Mummy and Daddy Pig realise they have run out of space at home! They decide to make their own home bigger with an extension.
Mr Bull arrives with his team to start work on Peppa's house renovation. Peppa and family move into the caravan in the garden while the work is being completed.
With the building work done, it's time to decorate! Peppa and George have fun choosing how to decorate their attic bedrooms. It's dinosaurs for George, but what will Peppa pick.
Mr Zebra arrives with a new car seat for the baby! Excited to try it in the car, the family soon realise it won't fit with Peppa and George too. It's time for a new car.
Granny and Grandpa Pig are taking Peppa and George to a festival - a jigsaw festival! Peppa is amazed by all of the completed jigsaws around the festival.
Madame Gazelle is making a wicker basket. She explains it is a hobby - something you do to relax. The children discuss hobbies and learn about each other's favourite things to do.
Mummy Pig and Peppa are at Granny Pig's house. They find Mummy's old patchwork quilt that Granny made for her as a baby. Peppa decides she'd like to make one for the baby.
Peppa is out with Suzy and Granny Sheep. They come across an old van that Miss Rabbit is recycling. Granny Sheep decides she would like to turn it into an art van.
It's Pie Swap Day! Humdinger sends Rocky Kitty to take one of Mr. Porter's tasty pies, so he can join the contest.
When Ms. Marjorie brings her bookmobile to Everest and the kids of the mountains, Maynard accidentally sets the van rolling and goes off on a wild ride.
A superfood cake creates some super heroes in 'Paddington's Hero Squad', then in 'Paddington's Knightly Quest', Paddington wants to become a Knight; but needs to complete heroic quests.
Windsor Gardens has two new heroes in 'Paddington the Rare Bear and Mr.Brilliant', then in 'Paddington and the Accidental Hero', Jonathan is hailed a hero after saving a rare gnome.
It's the annual fun run in Windsor Gardens park in 'Paddington Gets Fit', then in 'Paddington's Rocking Chair Repair', Mrs. Bird's much-loved rocking chair accidentally gets broken.
Tim, Tommy & Tia find a lost toy and vow to return it to its owner.
Tim, Tommy and Tia take on their parents at Tailball.
Tim and Kai attempt to rebuild Dad's childhood spaceship.
Ben and Holly set out to rescue Redbeard the Elf Pirate's sunken treasure. Mr Elf steers the Elf Submarine to the bottom of the lake, but then they are gobbled up by Big Bad Barry.
King Thistle wants fish for dinner, so he goes out fishing with Mr Elf, Ben and Holly on Mr Elf's boat. Mr Elf tells them a story about the biggest, baddest fish ever - Big Bad Barry.
Bat's the Way I Like It: The bats that nest in Grandad's shed each year are missing. Can Stan and Gran encourage these nocturnal creatures to return when they can't hear them.
Stan and Gran are enjoying a beach clean, but the rubbish seems to have a mind of its own! When a yoghurt pot goes walk-about, Stan spies a mystery.

There's a pirate-themed holiday in town, but Zuma isn't in a festive mood. His revamped persona gets tested when a real pirate arrives, bent on hidden treasure and ready to destroy the town to get it.
Baron Bite raids Jade's crystal caves in 'Cave Invaders', then in 'Stone Pangolin Surprise', Rammy turns into a big stone pangolin.
Wheeler discovers an ancient shell when 'The Crew Builds An Underwater Shell Museum', and then in 'The Crew Builds A Giant Shoe Store', ducks take Wheeler on a wild ride.
Farmer Al's new machine goes haywire in 'Pups Stop the Garboni', then in 'Pups Save the Porcupine', the Paw Patrol catch a trouble-making sleepy porcupine and bring it back to the woods.
Pups rescue Ace and Skye from a stuck plane in 'Pups and the Ace of Skies', then in 'Pups Save the Babysitter', Priya saves the pups at the farm.
Baron Bite steals a submarine from Sir Steel in 'Rise Of The Sub-Zero Sub', then in 'Balloon Bonanza', the Deer Squad's planet powers bring Trick Alien's giant balloon animals to life.
Tim, Tommy and Tia bird-sit the Bronte's MoonParrot.
Tim does all he can to get the new DinoStar toy.
Tim has a clear out of all his old stuff but soon finds not all of it is destined for the rubbish tip.
A Fairy Fly is coming to stay in the Fairy Tail Garden! But before they arrive, the Gabby Cats have to show they are true friends by being kind, helpful and welcoming.
Gabby unboxes some crayons and a colouring book with the same doodle on every page. But when CatRat gets stuck inside the book, Gabby and Pandy must go on a doodle rescue.
Farmer's snails go on strike in 'The Snail Whisperer', and then in 'Smurfs Might Fly', The Smurfs prepare for their sarsaparilla banquet, unaware that Gargamel has enchanted the thicket.
The pups have a fancy idea for Camila in 'The Crew Builds A Fancy Drive-Thru Restaurant', and in 'The Crew Builds A Castle Show', the pups search for Rosie before a show.
Sid Swashbuckle the Pirate and his first pup mate Arrby steal the giant pearl-making shell that gives Puplantis its magic.
While celebrating Friendship Day, the pups spring into action to stop Mayor Humdinger from ruining Adventure Bay's reputation as the friendliest town on the map.
The Paw Patrol is on an excavation dig when they unearth three fossilized eggs. Soon the eggs start to hatch, and three baby pterodactyls are running around.
Peppa and family go on an exciting trip to Paris to see the sights and meet Delphine Donkey and her family.
It's time for a day out and Peppa, George, Mummy Pig, Daddy Pig and Suzy Sheep all go to visit Tiny Land.
It's Richard Rabbit's birthday party and George is invited, and that can only mean one thing; Soft Play.
Grandpa Pig shares with Peppa and George his love of building toy planes and there is one extra special plane that Granny Pig has yet to see.
Peppa's family squeeze into the new car that Daddy Pig is trying out for fun.
Peppa is at Suzy's house and there is a pile of cardboard boxes so, they take them outside to play with. Peppa turns the boxes into a cardboard shop, a spaceship and even a hospital.
Miss Rabbit gives Peppa and friends a tennis lesson, but the tennis balls get everywhere! So, the children play badminton instead and it's a lot easier.
Peppa is on a play date with Candy Cat at Mr Cat's Cafe. Candy show Mr Cat the drawings they've done of everyone, and he hangs them up for everyone to see.
Holly breaks her wand and must go to the Wand Factory, at the bottom of the Great Elf Tree, to get it fixed.
A cake sale is organised to mend the magic school, but Queen Thistle is baking and no-one can eat her cakes.
It is harvest day. The Elves and fairies enlist the help of Mr Gnome in picking blackberries. If only they could stop him from eating them all..
The children have adopted a new pet - a dragon named Dave.
Mayor Humdinger's garbage-compacting truck is soiling the beach in 'Pups Save a Rubbish-Dinger', then in 'Pups Save the Royal Armour', a gift for the Princess gets scattered all over town.
Ryan Reynolds reads stories to help the world fall asleep. Tonight Ryan shares stories that are fully dressed.
Grandpa can't find his old metal detector to look for the key for George's new toy robot lost in the long grass.
Peppa and her friends play some very active games in the gar-den and together they learn to hop, skip and jump.
It is Molly Mole's first day at school and she quickly makes best friends with Peppa and Rebecca Rabbit.
Mummy Sheep gets the news that she has got a new job far away, leaving Suzy and Peppa to wonder how they're going to carry on being best friends.
Mummy Pig, Daddy Pig, Peppa and George go to the Skate Park with their bicycles, scooters and skateboards. Peppa has fun playing around on Daddy's skateboard.
Peppa and her family take a poorly swift to the vet's. After a night of rest, the swift recovers and Doctor Hamster releases it so it can fly around the world again.
At Chloe's party, the children and grownups struggle to finish the obstacle course to reach the prize. George is the last to try and finds the birthday cake.
During playgroup, Madame Gazelle takes everyone outside to play Parachute Games.
The Twins really want a pet and Nanny Plum sets about getting them one. She magics them up Pippin the hamster. The Wise Old Elf even brings Pippin a hamster wheel.
Ben, Holly and Gaston the Ladybird find a large egg in the meadow. A tiny chick hatches from the egg and the children must find the mummy bird.
Harold the Helicopter's dream to see the Northern Lights goes awry when the overly-excited engine race ignores warnings to stay away from the Sodor Suspension Bridge.
When Bruno's new map gets carried away by Kana's speedy whoosh, Thomas, Bruno, and friends search throughout Sodor for their buddy's prized possession.
Dora and Boots become Mermaids in 'Dora's Mermaid Adventure', then in 'Mermazing Surprise', Dora helps a dolphin find a magic jewel.
Tia's new balloon gets stuck in a tree, so Tim tries to get it down.
Tim, Tia and Tommy try to convince Mum and Dad to let them have a pet.
Tim and Kai go crater surfing and attempt a cool new trick.

Mummy Sheep gets the news that she has got a new job far away, leaving Suzy and Peppa to wonder how they're going to carry on being best friends.
Mummy Pig, Daddy Pig, Peppa and George go to the Skate Park with their bicycles, scooters and skateboards. Peppa has fun playing around on Daddy's skateboard.
Peppa and her family take a poorly swift to the vet's. After a night of rest, the swift recovers and Doctor Hamster releases it so it can fly around the world again.
At Chloe's party, the children and grownups struggle to finish the obstacle course to reach the prize. George is the last to try and finds the birthday cake.
During playgroup, Madame Gazelle takes everyone outside to play Parachute Games.
The Twins really want a pet and Nanny Plum sets about getting them one. She magics them up Pippin the hamster. The Wise Old Elf even brings Pippin a hamster wheel.
Ben, Holly and Gaston the Ladybird find a large egg in the meadow. A tiny chick hatches from the egg and the children must find the mummy bird.
Harold the Helicopter's dream to see the Northern Lights goes awry when the overly-excited engine race ignores warnings to stay away from the Sodor Suspension Bridge.
When Bruno's new map gets carried away by Kana's speedy whoosh, Thomas, Bruno, and friends search throughout Sodor for their buddy's prized possession.
Dora and Boots become Mermaids in 'Dora's Mermaid Adventure', then in 'Mermazing Surprise', Dora helps a dolphin find a magic jewel.
Tia's new balloon gets stuck in a tree, so Tim tries to get it down.
Tim, Tia and Tommy try to convince Mum and Dad to let them have a pet.
Tim and Kai go crater surfing and attempt a cool new trick.
Paddington must keep his promise to not make a mess in 'Paddington's Goo Monster', then in 'Paddington's Apple Pip Adventure', Paddington and Simi go on a journey into the human body.

Peppa is playing at Suzy's house and they find out that Granny Sheep is moving in! She transforms the dull spare room and attic into an exotic boudoir and creative studio.
Peppa is at Suzy's house and there is a pile of cardboard boxes so, they take them outside to play with. Peppa turns the boxes into a cardboard shop, a spaceship and even a hospital.
Suzy describes a takeaway and the children want to make their own. Together they 'cook' and deliver the pretend takeaways to the parents. They get great reviews too.
Grandpa Pig has created a watering system, but he does not remember which button is which so Peppa and George help using walkie talkies. The Police hear their signal and are surprised.
Mummy and Daddy Pig are working in their home office and Peppa wants to 'work' like them too. Peppa decides that she needs her own office, so she takes the cupboard under the stairs.
Peppa and her family take a poorly swift to the vet's. After a night of rest, the swift recovers and Doctor Hamster releases it so it can fly around the world again.
Peppa and her family are visiting Cousin Chloe's House to play with Baby Alexander. Peppa learns babies are not like dolls at all, and do lots of things every day.
Peppa hands Penny and Pedro the wrong glasses by mistake and they can't see very well. Madame Gazelle then tells them the importance of lenses and how they're in all sorts of things.
It's a snowy day and Peppa's family build an igloo for their snowman. They then hide away in it during the snowstorm, but Penny Polar Bear and her parents love snowstorms and Peppa's igloo too.
Peppa and her friends are at playgroup when everyone finds out that Mr Bull and Mrs Cow are going to get married the next day.
Everyone is getting ready for Mr Bull and Mrs Cow's wedding, going to the jewellers to get rings, to the dress makers... and to sort out the wedding cake.
Holly spends the day with King Thistle on his royal duties. King Thistle must launch an elf boat, judge a fairy fruit competition and make a speech at the festival.
The children are at the Elf Farm, but to learn where milk comes from they must visit a big farm, to find cows. They travel to Lucy Big's farm, where she shows them all the animals.
Peppa looks after Madame Gazelle's guinea pigs Ginger and Brian while she goes on holiday, but prove to be more trouble for Mummy and Daddy Pig than they think.
Peppa and her friends are at playgroup when Mr. Bull arrives to do some noisy work - he is building a windmill, to make electricity! The children join in and make their own windmills too.
Mummy Pig suggests they all make pizzas together, so everyone prepares and chooses the food to make their own individual pizzas.
Peppa and her family hire a canoe from Miss Rabbit. They imagine they are in a jungle and then actually bump into Mrs Crocodile. Then Mr Lion invites them to a picnic.
There's a new friend for Peppa at her playgroup, Lotte Lama. She can speak a foreign language. Peppa loves talking. Everyone loves talking.
Peppa is excited to help George explore the world of sounds now he has his new hearing aid. She shows him her favourite sounds including the splashing of a muddy puddle.
Peppa and her friends are introduced to some simple woodcraft in the woods with Mr Wolf.
Mummy and Daddy Pig get stuck behind Mrs Badger's tractor on the way to her farm, where Peppa and George learn about how useful tractors can be, even if they aren't very fast.
Grampy Rabbit teaches Danny Dog and Peppa why his lifeboat is so important when it comes to saving lives at sea, and gives them tips on how to stay safe.
Pedro loves superheroes. He has a superhero-themed party and Super Potato is one of the guests.
At the playgroup, Madame Gazelle is reading a story, but a page is missing so she makes up an ending. During playtime, the children make up their own endings too.
Peppa and friends are at Penny Polar Bear's house for a movie night. But before they can watch it, the children need to decide where to sit, and which popcorn to eat.
The children make good use of their clubhouse by playing an adventure game, imaginging that there are wild animals outside - even if it is just Daddy Pig.
Peppa and her friends go to school early to have breakfast together.
Police Officer Panda and Police Officer Squirrel visit Peppa's playgroup. They offer two lucky children the chance to spend the day with them.
Miss Rabbit takes the children for swimming lessons in the little children's pool. At the end of the lesson, giant inflatables are brought out including an inflatable slide.
Today is the grown-ups' singing competition at the theatre and the kids are the judges. The children jump up and down and sing along. Everybody loves singing.
It's the day of the duck race! When Miss Rabbit gives the sign, everyone drops their ducks in the river at the first bridge - whose will make it to the second bridge first.
Mr Bull arrives with his team to start work on Peppa's house renovation. Peppa and family move into the caravan in the garden while the work is being completed.
Madame Gazelle gets the playgroup to play music - with instruments that they must make themselves.
George and Peppa spend the day playing golf with Grandpa Pig, but they are much more interested in the colourful minigolf course next door.
On a day out with her family, Peppa is encouraged to find words to describe the different kinds of puddles they find.
Peppa and Rebecca Rabbit pretend to be babies to get Mummy Rabbit's attention. Mummy Rabbit plays along until they admit they are not really babies.
Dr Hamster is visiting the playgroup today and has brought a giant ant farm. But nobody notices when they escape and start moving things in the classroom.

Grampy Rabbit's new jet pack shoots off into the distance and he ends up on top of a snowy mountain.
Peppa Pig goes to the park to play with friends and have new experiences.
When Daddy Pig gets a parking ticket, Peppa and George learn that grown-ups have rules just like children - and get told off too.
When Peppa decides to walk up the big hill during their family hike in the countryside, Daddy Pig assures her that the hard climb will be worth it.
Daddy Pig thinks perhaps he should run the London Marathon to teach his children about determination! Daddy enlists Peppa and George to help with training in the park.
Madame Gazelle is making a wicker basket. She explains it is a hobby - something you do to relax. The children discuss hobbies and learn about each other's favourite things to do.
With the building work done, it's time to decorate! Peppa and George have fun choosing how to decorate their attic bedrooms. It's dinosaurs for George, but what will Peppa pick.
Peppa and George's toy basket is full and their beds are covered in toys. So, Mummy Pig decides it is time to order a new toy cupboard. Mummy and Daddy Pig are not very good at DIY.
Peppa and George look after Granny and Grandpa's parrot.
Peppa, George and all their friends go for a ride on Grandpa Pig's fantastic little train.
Peppa is going for a sleepover at Zoe Zebra's house. Suzy Sheep, Rebecca Rabbit, Candy Cat and Emily Elephant are coming over too. The girls are all too excited to sleep.
It is night time at Grandpa and Granny Pig's house, Peppa and George have stayed up late to help hunt for slugs and snails. But what other night animals will they find.
Peppa and George make everyone laugh when they dress up as Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig.
When Daddy Pig loses his glasses he gets a bit grumpy. But Peppa and George have lots of fun looking for them.
Madame Gazelle takes Peppa and her friends on a train ride, where they must tick off what they see on their activity sheets.
Peppa and family go on a walk through the forests where they meet all their favourite fairytale characters.
It is International Day at playgroup and Peppa and her friends have dressed up as countries of the world.
Grandpa Pig teaches Peppa and her friends all about bugs, insects and creepy crawlies.
Peppa and Suzy Sheep are best friends. But one day they have a quarrel, and decide they are not best friends anymore. As time goes by they really miss each other - will they make up.
When the school roof is broken and needs fixing, Peppa volunteers Mummy Pig to do a parachute jump to raise money for it. Daddy Pig goes up too and has to overcome his fear of heights.
Mummy Pig has finally finished writing her first book and decides to take it to playgroup to read to the children with unexpected results.
Peppa and George love going to the beach on sunny days. They bring their water wings, a beach ball and their buckets and spades. Peppa and George have fun burying Daddy Pig in the sand.
Peppa and George go on a boat trip with Grandpa Pig, but they must send for help when their boat runs aground. Polly Parrot fetches Granny Pig and Granddad Dog, who rescues them.
Peppa and George's visit a restaurant, where they have a great time asking for everything they would expect at a party.
It is bedtime and Peppa calls Kylie Kangaroo and is surprised to learn it's not morning or winter where she is! Daddy Pig explains this using a big ball to represent the earth.
Peppa and family come to help make a garden on the roof of the apartments. Mr Bull assists with a big truck and crane. There is even a little something for Mrs Duck.

Daddy Pig teaches Peppa to ride her bicycle without stabilisers - just like her friends.
It is a rainy day but Peppa doesn't mind - her garden is full of lovely, muddy puddles.

Max agrees to mentor Captain Perfect's younger sister, who is headed down the path of becoming a supervillain. She tries to become one of Mastermind's henchmen.
